title: 35th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/35/2024).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. އޖ/20/2024/ޚޞ/1 to އޖ/20/2024/ޚޞ/3, the three special sittings).

From the Speaker's desk: under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the bill amending Law No. 10/2011 (Goods and Services Tax Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu West MP Mohamed Mustafa Ibrahim.

Preliminary debate on the bill amending Law No. 29/2016 (Act on Taxes and Fees Collected from Passengers Departing the Maldives from an Airport), submitted on behalf of the government by Gemanafushi MP Asadhulla Shihab.
Preliminary debate on the bill amending Law No. 2/99 (Maldives Tourism Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangolhi South MP Mustafa Hussain.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to send an ambassador nomination to committee and open debate on three government tax bills covering GST, airport departure fees and tourism.
